conditions.seed: existing unchanged Rng1 8128 / Rng2 0x8128a5a5 native spawn; no reseed/retry search
conditions.schedule: W1-48; then mirrored D/A and Space49 plus fixed stationary Native landing period; no contact-dependent jump input
conditions.controller: Each 60Hz Momentum input observes actual velocity/body/gun yaw; wish targets perpendicular to actual incoming velocity. Pure default dynamic-camera yaw predictor chooses raw mouse via20 bounded inverse iterations, +/-256px, quantized1/256px. No engine lookahead or state writes.
conditions.baseline: Fresh Native arm replays the exact recorded Momentum raw key/mouse trace, not an independently adaptive policy. Controller-generated traces differ by Hunter/map/mirror; every prescribed case and failure is retained.
conditions.predictor: PlayerInput.UpdateAimY(0), UpdateAimX, UpdateAimFacing default zero-pitch/nozoom path only; actual next facing checked within0.02degree, otherwise capture fails closed. No private aim method invocation or production API.
conditions.capWitness: Numerical regular-cap witness: actual eligible air/legal-jump step is SpeedLimited with no incoming overspeed, uncapped outside cap and actual seam inside. Pre/post pad/boost/hazard/acceleration/locks/Q3 and eligibility observations qualify provenance; any observed external path prevents unqualified arm acceptance. Incoming speed alone does not establish impulse history; incoming overspeed exemptions retained.
conditions.collision: Actual native counter deltas and body trajectories only. Zero overflow/recovery does not by itself prove no penetration; nonzero counters require review. Fixed geometry can prevent cap coverage without implying a solver failure.
conditions.retention: All480 commands/body/solver observations retained when completed; failing arms retain generated command and completed sample prefixes; all later prescribed cases still attempted; missing calibration explicitly not run. No favorable rerolls or profile changes.
